stages.title: Garden Path
stages.hint: The goal is close, but the hedges choose the path. Follow it all the way round.

stages.title: Nudge
stages.hint: Walk into a block to push it ahead of you.

stages.title: Look Before You Push
stages.hint: Blocks can't be pulled. If a push goes wrong, undo it and try the block from another side.

stages.title: Stepping Stone
stages.hint: A block pushed into a hole fills it. Line it up with the gap first.

stages.title: Both Feet
stages.hint: A long block only falls when all of it is over holes.

stages.title: Mind the Gap
stages.hint: A long block needs a long gap. Decide which block each gap is for before you push.

stages.title: Footbridge
stages.hint: Blocks can slide over a gap that you can't cross. Build your bridge where your feet will need it.

stages.title: Plank Run
stages.hint: The plank glides over single holes, but you need floor to push from. Choose where the stone lands.

stages.title: Shape Sorter
stages.hint: Each pit has a shape. A smaller block can fall into a bigger pit and spoil it.

stages.title: Single File
stages.hint: You can't push a block from a cell that's over a hole. Send the blocks down the corridor in the right order.

stages.title: Revolving Door
stages.hint: Push the arm from the side and the swivel turns around its center. It may need more than one turn.

stages.title: Clockwork Corner
stages.hint: Stand between two arms and push one; the swivel takes you along.

stages.title: Windmill Lift
stages.hint: The windmill never changes shape, but it will carry you round its corners.

stages.title: Three Hinges
stages.hint: Every hinge can be closed again, and some of them have to be.

stages.title: Round the Hinge
stages.hint: The bar you open first is in the way at the very end.

stages.title: Make Way
stages.hint: Only your partner can fill the gap. Switch to them with C (X on a controller), and stay out of their way.

stages.title: Bucket Brigade
stages.hint: Each of you can push in one direction only. Pass each block along, then step back for the next.

stages.title: Down the Chute
stages.hint: Every block that reaches the bottom row goes down the one narrow chute.

stages.title: Swing Gate
stages.hint: The last hole needs a block from the far side of the swing gate. Swing it so a block can get past.

stages.title: Long Way Round
stages.hint: The last block has to be pushed from above. Find a way around to get there.
